summary: Stewart County tower on Tennessee's lookout list at 693 ft (211 m), marked removed; no other source found on its history or the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed; no source describes what remains at the site.

evidence.supports: List row: Big A, Stewart County, elevation 693 ft, marked removed

notes_for_editor: One list row supports the tower. Two Tennessee web searches found no other record of a Big A tower in Stewart County. The list gives a second code, 6-18, that the page does not explain, so it is left out of the story. The story is short on purpose, below the 120-word target, rather than padded. Consider a Stewart County or Tennessee Division of Forestry source before publishing.
